title: nan
authors: Yang T.; Ren Q.; Zhang F.; Xie B.; Ren H.; Li J.; Zhang Y.
key_contribution: Presents a hybrid camera array (fisheye + stereo) perception and motion-compensated controller for autonomous UAV landing on a moving UGV in GPS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
